decisions.reason: Gives a clear history: the marker was removed in alpha.1 and its retention restored in alpha.2. Works out that the marker is present on alpha.2 and applies this to produceExternalEvent in src/events.ts.

Finds the delete statement, rejects the comment's reasoning as backwards, and recommends deleting both the defense and the comment. Notes the delete does nothing because the literal has no marker. Separates removing the stripping code from setting a marker through a trick.

Says ignorable:true only suits informational events whose absence does not change session semantics. Says it is not a filtering directive for readers and that marked events stay in the loaded log. Applies this only as a conditional, given the append limitation.

Says public Session.append has no ignorable parameter and treats this as a capability gap. Forbids casts and hand-edited JSONL. Defers any integration until a supported mechanism exists, and proposes typechecking against the real alpha.2 declarations.

caps.reason: The report recommends deleting the defense. It never recommends continuing to strip the marker.
